name: Air Force Logistics University
zhAliases: 中国人民解放军空军后勤学院

evidence.summary: CASI describes the PLA Air Force’s logistics college in Xuzhou (空军勤务学院, which it translates as Air Force Logistics College), founded in 1954 as the PLA Air Force Rear Service School, as reporting to PLA Air Force headquarters; its facilities include an aviation fuel and materials department.
The college reports to PLA Air Force headquarters.

sources.title: The People’s Liberation Army’s 37 Academic Institutions (2020), pp. 195–196
sources.publisher: China Aerospace Studies Institute, US Air Force Air University
